app.title: Horde Mode Atlas
app.tagline: Top-down maps of the World War Z Horde Mode arenas
seo.h1: World War Z Horde Mode Maps
seo.mapHeading: {name} - World War Z Horde Mode map
seo.about: Each of the five World War Z Horde Mode maps here is a top-down reconstruction of the arena: where breaching charges spawn, where the shops and lootboxes are, where the gates, machine guns and electric fences stand, and which surfaces the horde can actually walk on.
meta.description: Interactive top-down maps of the five World War Z Horde Mode arenas: breaching charges, shops, lootboxes, machine guns, spawns and the walkable navmesh.
hint.controls: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, right-click to tilt. “Recenter” returns to the top-down view.
hint.controlsTouch: One finger drags the map, pinch to zoom, twist to turn, two fingers to tilt. Tap a marker to read it.
error.load: This arena could not be loaded.
error.webgl: WebGL is not available in this browser.
about.title: About
about.body: Unofficial fan project. Each arena is rebuilt from the collision volumes and the navmesh of a local copy of the game. It is a reconstruction, not an official document.
about.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Saber Interactive or Focus Entertainment. World War Z and all related marks belong to their respective owners.
